findings.text: IA32 misc enable uses single bit selectors at fixed offsets: fast string at 0, thermal control at 1, EMON at 7, BTS unavailable at 11, PEBS unavailable at 12, enhanced speedstep at 16, MWAIT at 18, limit CPUID at 22, xTPR disable at 23, and XD disable at 34, where each mask isolates only its named offset.

A second misc enable group defines further single bit selectors: x87 compatibility at 2, TM1 at 3, split lock disable at 4, L3 cache disable at 6, suppress lock at 8, prefetch disable at 9, FERR at 10, TM2 at 13, adjacent prefetch disable at 19, speedstep lock at 20, L1D context at 24, DCU prefetch disable at 37, turbo disable at 38, and IP prefetch disable at 39. Two FERR labels share position 10 as aliases, and each mask isolates only its stated offset.

Misc feature enables resides at 0x140 with CPUID fault at bit 0 and ring3 MWAIT at bit 1. TSC deadline resides at 0x6E0. TSX force abort resides at 0x10F with RTM force abort at 0, TSX CPUID clear at 1, and SDV enable RTM at 2, each mask isolating its single position.
Machine check guest state spans eleven consecutive addresses from 0x180 through 0x18A in general register order: EAX, EBX, ECX, EDX, ESI, EDI, EBP, ESP, EFLAGS, EIP, then a reserved slot.

Pentium 4 performance counters use contiguous blocks: BPU counters at 0x300 through 0x303, MS counters at 0x304 through 0x307, flame counters at 0x308 through 0x30B, and IQ counters at 0x30C through 0x311. Counter controls follow at BPU 0x360 through 0x363, MS 0x364 through 0x367, flame 0x368 through 0x36B, and IQ 0x36C through 0x371.

Event selectors occupy paired addresses: BSU 0x3A0-0x3A1, FSB 0x3A2-0x3A3, FIRM 0x3A4-0x3A5, FLAME 0x3A6-0x3A7, DAC 0x3A8-0x3A9, MOB 0x3AA-0x3AB, PMH 0x3AC-0x3AD, SAAT 0x3AE-0x3AF, U2L 0x3B0-0x3B1, BPU 0x3B2-0x3B3, IS 0x3B4-0x3B5, ITLB 0x3B6-0x3B7, CRU 0x3B8-0x3B9 plus 0x3CC-0x3CD plus 0x3E0-0x3E1, RAT 0x3BC-0x3BD, SSU 0x3BE-0x3BF, MS 0x3C0-0x3C1, TBPU 0x3C2-0x3C3, TC 0x3C4-0x3C5, IX 0x3C8-0x3C9, ALF 0x3CA-0x3CB, and PEBS matrix vertical at 0x3F2.

Architectural fixed counters reside at 0x309 through 0x30C, with fixed control at 0x38D, global status at 0x38E, global control at 0x38F, overflow control at 0x390, status set at 0x391, and performance metrics at 0x329.
Global overflow control defines isolated flags at 55 for trace TOPA PMI, at 62 for overflow buffer, and at 63 for condition changed, each mask selecting only its position.
Geode bus controller configuration zero resides at 0x1900.

VMX capability reporting occupies nineteen consecutive addresses from 0x480 through 0x492 covering basic, pin controls, processor controls, exit controls, entry controls, misc, fixed zero and one for CR0 and CR4, VMCS enumeration, second processor controls, EPT VPID capability, true pin, true processor, true exit and true entry controls, VM function, and third processor controls, with MCU staging mailbox address separate at 0x7A5.

Quality and resource monitoring uses L3 QoS config at 0xC81, L2 QoS config at 0xC82, event select at 0xC8D, counter at 0xC8E, association at 0xC8F, L3 mask base at 0xC90, SNC config at 0xCA0, L2 mask base at 0xD10, and MBA throttle base at 0xD50.
Bandwidth allocation bases reside high: MBA at 0xC0000200, soft MBA at 0xC0000280, L3 ABMC config at 0xC00003FD, L3 extended config at 0xC00003FF, and event config base at 0xC0000400.
SVM control uses VM_CR at 0xC0010114, IGNNE at 0xC0010115, and HSAVE physical address at 0xC0010117, with valid mask 0x1F, lock mask 0x08, and disable mask 0x10.
Hardware feedback pointer resides at 0x17D0 with its configuration register next at 0x17D1.
xAPIC disable status resides at 0xBD with legacy disabled signaled by bit 0, indicating locked x2APIC mode where an attempt to disable faults.
Non serializing MSR write encoding is defined as a three byte sequence with values fifteen, one and one hundred ninety eight in order.

MTRR capability isolates count in low eight bits, fixed range support at bit 8, and write combining at bit 10. Default type isolates type in low eight bits with fixed enable at 10 and overall enable at 11, where enabled combines both enables and disabled is the complement of type plus enables. Base isolates type in low eight with reserved spanning 11 through 8, while mask reserves low eleven and uses bit 11 as valid.

msr_info bundles a 32 bit register number with a value holder, a per CPU pointer to values, and an error field. msr_regs_info bundles a pointer to 32 bit register slots with an error field. saved_msr pairs a validity flag with an msr_info snapshot. saved_msrs pairs a count with a pointer to an array of saved snapshots.

MTRR saved state holds an array of variable ranges sized by the architectural maximum, an array of fixed range types sized by the fixed count, an enabled flag, a fixed support boolean, and a default type.
MSR tracing identifies its subsystem as msr, its include file as msr-trace, and its include path as asm, protected by a dedicated header guard.
Both MSR and MTRR public headers use once only inclusion guards keyed to their paths.

Single bit masks throughout these definitions isolate exactly one position by shifting a single one by the associated bit number, including misc enable, feature enables, TSX controls, and overflow control.

Low level accessors provide direct register operations. The always inline write installs a 64 bit value into the named register with fault containment. The native read returns the 64 bit value of the named register and records a trace event when tracing is active. The native safe write attempts the install, reports zero on success and nonzero on fault, and records tracing. The native PMC read returns the counter selected by the index and records tracing. The PMC trace helper itself is a no operation in this configuration.

Split helpers convert between 64 bit values and paired 32 bit halves. The unsafe read assigns halves into caller slots, the unsafe write merges halves into a single install, the safe 64 bit write and safe split read return completion status with the safe read storing through caller pointers, and the PMC helper forwards its counter index to the native read.

Single CPU fallback helpers ignore their CPU and mask arguments and operate on CPU zero in this configuration. Read on CPUs writes into the per CPU slot, write on CPUs loads from that slot, and safe single and safe register array variants forward to the corresponding local safe operation and return its status.

When MTRR support is compiled out, management helpers become inert. Guest force and fixed save and state save and boot init and disable and enable and generic set perform no action, range add and page add and range delete and page delete return negative ENODEV, and uncached trim returns zero.

Direct MSR installation splits the 64 bit payload across low and high halves with the register number in the selector input and a memory barrier effect. Unsafe forms rely on exception table recovery at a continuation label, while safe forms capture the fault into a status result instead of propagating.
